title: A design system changes colours, faces, radii and shadows only: the slot writes no container width or section rhythm, button sizes stop at forms; the preview detectors catch moved rows, kept status hues and unworn pages; Tracy Business EmDash is open to customers
expect: S1: every test passes: no contract makes the slot write a content width; button padding selectors all carry :where(:not(form *)); every contract fits its Joomla module under every library system (Tracy Business Joomla with modesAuto false).
S2: every test passes: LAYOUT-3 sees a row that moved, status-hue a kept status hue, unworn-page a page whose system vars resolve to the template palette; every declared page is sampled.
S3: every test passes: emdash/tracy-business and joomla/tracy-business are open to customers, every other template locked, staff pass.
evidence: Under Moxie and Figma the five templates changed layout (JA Kinetic footer newsletter row wrapped, inner-page columns off their left edge) and the home-page-only probe saw nothing
fence: the template's layout never changes under a system; a locked template stays locked for customers
